test_title: PYST 72: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 28 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice which can be formed on folding the given sheet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e010fa82a60f203061fde8e19877aa54ec688084530432af68b3b251fe0eda23.png]
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca4b7d68bb91886711b05253e0a0a1b7a5dd0ad766797d3bf6b7aaa728d58586.png] 

From the dice we can see,

J is opposite to G,

F is opposite to H,

E is opposite to I

And, two opposite sides can not be the adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shows in a dice.

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b3ccdf21f53682a36e2a0286a1f989abe6aefae08159c3207bd5c5344cc056e.png] → Can not be made, because G and J is the opposite sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49c70c6bd7d30577093c1a4707c50483439092e83a1440f23fcce3a4dd7d93db.png] → Can not be made, because I and E is the opposite sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7363641d80878d108c2f97978b0509fdff9c0439cccad36df7cabceb4df40fb3.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are adjacent sides.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36c147eee5b78204e7c5e3bdd9696853ab958e02042bbc94f148b67cc20ac087.png] → Can not be made, because F and H is the opposite sides.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
